zh.label: 系统核心
zh.desc: 引导程序、内核与驱动、系统卷、虚拟内存文件。删除或改动可能导致无法开机。

zh.label: 正在使用
zh.desc: 正被运行中的程序执行、加载（动态库）或打开的文件。

zh.label: 系统文件
zh.desc: 操作系统自带或已安装程序的文件，应通过卸载程序/包管理器移除，而不是手动删除。

zh.label: 配置文件
zh.desc: 系统设置与用户设置、注册表、SSH/GPG 密钥等。

zh.label: 用户数据
zh.desc: 个人文件：文档、下载、项目、媒体等。

zh.label: 缓存/临时
zh.desc: 缓存、日志、临时文件、回收站、可重新下载的依赖包。通常可以安全清理。

zh.label: 其他/应用数据
zh.desc: 未归入以上类别的程序数据，例如数据库、容器镜像、AppData、~/Library 中的应用数据。

en.label: System core
en.desc: Boot loader, kernel and drivers, system volume, virtual memory files. Deleting or changing them can make the system unbootable.

en.label: In use
en.desc: Files that a running program is executing, has loaded (libraries) or has open.

en.label: System files
en.desc: Files of the operating system or installed programs. Remove them by uninstalling (package manager / app settings), not by deleting them by hand.

en.label: Settings
en.desc: System and user settings, registry, SSH/GPG keys and the like.

en.label: Personal files
en.desc: Personal files: documents, downloads, projects, media.

en.label: Cache / temp
en.desc: Caches, logs, temporary files, trash, re-downloadable packages. Usually safe to clean up.

en.label: App data / other
en.desc: Program data not in the categories above, e.g. databases, container images, AppData, application data in ~/Library.
